title: The Big Match
lines: Ben and Meg have a pitching match.
Both of them stand on the bridge.
Ben pitches a stick in the ditch.
Meg fetches it and pitches it back.
A duck on the hedge is the judge.
Ben hits the hedge and the duck quacks.
Meg wins the match and gets the badge.
Then the pals munch fudge on the bridge.

questions.ask: Who is the judge in this match?
questions.listenFor: A duck sitting on the hedge. Stated in the story - have them find that line and read it back.
His stick hit the hedge and woke the duck. If they say "Meg won," ask "and what did Ben's stick do?"

questions.ask: Do you think a duck makes a good judge? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Silly question on purpose - any answer is right. You are listening for the reason after it, not the yes or no.
